tagline: Deterministic Asynchronous Event Orchestrator and Webhook Chaos-Testing Platform
hackathonTheme: One Week. One Loop. Every PR.
problemStatement: Modern SaaS applications fail silently when decoupled webhooks are delayed, duplicated, or dropped, especially in high-latency or unstable CI/CD deployment environments. Traditional unit tests mock handlers, missing cryptographic signature checks, race conditions, and DOM desynchronization.
solution: AetherWeave intercepts asynchronous webhooks between third-party providers and preview/local backends, injecting deterministic chaos (latency, duplication, packet drops, sequence scrambling) to verify eventual consistency and mathematical idempotency with TestSprite.

architecture.styling: Tailwind CSS with futuristic dark glassmorphism (cyan and purple neon accents)
architecture.verification: TestSprite CI/CD gate with Vercel preview environments
